rationale: The assistant correctly identified the TCM580GUK as falling within the Hotpoint/Indesit/Creda lint-on-heater recall programme in its first reply and directed the customer to the Whirlpool safety checker/helpline, then after hearing 'no sticker, secondhand, no letter' firmly advised not using it until confirmed. It used the customer's evidence faithfully (thick fluff, packed condenser, came with the house), correctly attributed slow drying to the neglected filter/condenser without claiming that cleaning resolves the fire risk, and recommended no parts. The only weaknesses are that the first turn permitted supervised use pending the check rather than an outright stop/unplug, and the long cleaning checklist was front-loaded before recall status was resolved.
